verdict.rationale: Marketing copy says Hummingbird automates routine work and moves cases between agents and the human team, and the docs say workflows can be configured to mirror an organization's policies. That points to policy-shaped automation with human handoff, but only at a high level. missing for 10: documented policy controls that limit or gate automatic dispositioning, explicit risk- or ambiguity-based escalation rules or thresholds, detailed first-party docs on agent-to-human handoff, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can limit automatic remediation by policy and escalate ambiguous or high-risk findings to a human

citations.quote: It automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team, and keeps every decision defensible.
We can easily configure your Hummingbird account with workflows that mirror your policies.
Screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently. Streamline your onboarding, ongoing monitoring, or ad-hoc investigations using customizable automation
